function.name: download_image
function.description: Downloads an image from a direct HTTP(S) link on the internet and keeps it in a short-lived store. Returns an image_id plus metadata (no image bytes). Use it right before send_image whenever the teacher wants an internet picture in this chat.

image_url.description: Direct link to an image file (ends with .jpg/.png/.gif etc., or an image CDN link), never a web page. Take it from search_images results or from the teacher's message.
